simple.summary: רָעַל (râʻal) means to reel , i.e. (figuratively) to brandish First listed occurrence: Nah 2 4.

definitions.full: H7477. raal [ רָעַל ] verb quiver, shake, reel (Aramaic רְעַל , , quiver, shake, tremble ; Arabic the hanging part of a sheep's split ear, also (Frey) a kind of veil of which a part hangs down in front; dangling ; Lihyanian has proper name רעל DHM Epigr. Denkm. Arabic 38); — Hoph`al Perfect 3plural הָרְעָ֑לוּ הַבְּרשְׁים Nahum 2:4 are made to quiver. See also [ עָרַל ].
